name: Idle Watch
author: ionutm87
description: Warns about hung processes and heavy CPU/GPU use while you are away

barWidget.description: Green check when all is well, a warning when something is wrong: hung orphan processes, heavy CPU/GPU/heat after a stretch with no input, failed units, crashes, OOM kills, full disks. Sends a critical notification once per issue.

schema.label: Idle after (minutes)
schema.description: Minutes with no keyboard/mouse input before CPU/GPU checks start.

schema.label: Process CPU while idle (%)
schema.description: Per-process CPU, as percent of one core, that counts as heavy while idle.

schema.label: NVIDIA GPU while idle (%)
schema.description: dGPU utilization that counts as heavy while idle. A suspended dGPU is never woken to check.

schema.label: CPU temperature while idle (°C)
schema.description: Package temperature that counts as too hot while idle.

schema.label: Hung after (minutes)
schema.description: An orphaned process averaging over half a core for this long is reported as hung, idle or not.
